d: Short, wavy cornflower blue hair with messy bangs and a youthful face reflecting a teenager's maturity. Golden-amber eyes with a gentle, curious expression. A slim, petite build dressed in an ochre-orange short-sleeved jacket over a dark undershirt, paired with a light grey utility skirt, a matching grey waist-bag, and a thick ochre-colored scarf wrapped around the neck. Accessories include a dark grey flat cap with bronze goggles perched on top, white fingerless gloves, black knee-high socks, and black lace-up boots.
